How to order

Four steps, all on WhatsApp.

  1. Choose your pair

    Browse the collection and add your favourites to the cart.

  2. Send your order

    Press send and your order opens on WhatsApp, already written for you.

  3. Confirm size and pay

    We confirm your size and stock, then agree payment and delivery with you.

  4. Collect or receive

    Collect from us in Lusaka or arrange delivery.
